# html2canvas 1.4.1

Upstream: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas/tree/v1.4.1

MIT license retained in LICENSE and the distribution header. Unmodified minified distribution SHA-256: `e87e550794322e574a1fda0c1549a3c70dae5a93d9113417a429016838eab8cb`.
